name: Bodyweight Squat
form_checklist: Keep your lower back flat | Knees aligned with toes
common_mistakes: Knees caving inward. | Heels lifting off the floor. | Rounding the lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out. | Brace your core and push your hips back as if sitting into a chair. | Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, or only as far as feels comfortable, keeping your heels down. | Press through your whole foot to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: Forward Lunge
common_mistakes: Letting the front knee collapse inward. | Taking too short a step, which overloads the front knee. | Leaning the chest far forward.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips. | Step forward into a comfortable stride length. | Lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees. | Push through the front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

name: Standing Calf Raise
common_mistakes: Rolling the ankles outward. | Bouncing instead of lowering with control.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Rest one hand on a wall or chair for balance. | Press up onto the balls of your feet as high as you comfortably can. | Pause for one second at the top. | Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

name: Lying Straight Leg Raise
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back off the mat. | Swinging the leg up with momentum.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight. | Tighten the thigh muscle of the straight leg. | Lift that leg until it is level with your bent knee, keeping it straight. | Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Wall Sit
common_mistakes: Holding your breath. | Resting your hands on your thighs, which takes the load off your legs. | Letting the knees drift inward.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about 60 cm (2 ft) in front of you. | Slide down until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees, or stay higher if that feels better. | Keep your back flat on the wall and breathe steadily. | Hold for the set time, then slide back up.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
common_mistakes: Choosing a weight so heavy that your form breaks down. | Letting the chest drop forward.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands. | Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall and elbows inside your knees. | Drive through your feet to stand up.

name: Glute Bridge
common_mistakes: Lifting so high that the lower back arches. | Letting the knees fall apart.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. | Press through your heels and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from shoulders to knees. | Squeeze your glutes for one second at the top. | Lower your hips slowly.

name: Clamshell
common_mistakes: Rolling the hips backward. | Moving too fast.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together. | Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked. | Lift your top knee while your feet stay touching. | Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
common_mistakes: Rounding the back. | Bending the knees so much that it becomes a squat. | Starting with weights that are too heavy.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs. | With a soft bend in your knees, push your hips back and slide the weights down your legs. | Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs, keeping your back flat. | Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

name: Push-Up
form_checklist: Keep body in a straight line | Elbows 45 degrees from body
common_mistakes: Sagging hips. | Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides. | Only moving through a small range.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than your shoulders. | Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels. | Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. | Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Incline Push-Up
common_mistakes: Pushing the hips back. | Using a surface that can slide or wobble.
instructions: Place your hands on a sturdy counter, bench or wall, slightly wider than your shoulders. | Walk your feet back until your body makes a straight line. | Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the surface. | Press away until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
common_mistakes: Letting the elbows flare wide. | Bouncing the arms off the floor.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest. | Lower your elbows until your upper arms lightly touch the floor. | Press the weights up until your arms are straight. | Keep your wrists straight and your core gently braced.

name: Chair Dips
common_mistakes: Using a chair that can slide. | Dropping too deep, which strains the shoulders. | Letting the elbows flare out.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair placed against a wall and put your hands beside your hips. | Slide your hips off the seat with your knees bent. | Bend your elbows straight back to lower a few inches. | Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
common_mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight. | Letting the elbows drift forward.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the weights up toward your shoulders. | Lower them slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back. | Using weights that are too heavy.
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward. | Brace your core. | Press the weights overhead until your arms are almost straight. | Lower them with control.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
common_mistakes: Pulling too hard. | Shrugging the shoulder toward your ear.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest. | Use your other hand to hold it gently just above the elbow. | Draw it closer until you feel a mild stretch, never pain. | Hold, breathe slowly, then switch arms.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
common_mistakes: Twisting the torso. | Rounding the back.
instructions: Rest one hand on a sturdy chair or bench with a flat back, holding a dumbbell in the other hand. | Let the weight hang straight down. | Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade back. | Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Pull-Apart
common_mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders. | Letting the ribs flare out.
instructions: Hold a light resistance band in front of you at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width apart. | Keep your arms straight and gently squeeze your shoulder blades together. | Pull the band apart until it reaches your chest. | Return slowly.

name: Superman Hold
common_mistakes: Lifting too high. | Looking up and straining the neck.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front and legs straight. | Gently lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor. | Keep your neck neutral with your eyes on the floor. | Hold briefly, then lower with control.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
common_mistakes: Moving too quickly. | Forcing the end of your range of motion.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. | Inhale: let your belly drop and lift your chest and tailbone (cow). | Exhale: round your spine and tuck your chin (cat). | Move slowly with your breath.

name: Forearm Plank
common_mistakes: Sagging hips. | Piking the hips up. | Holding your breath.
instructions: Place your forearms on the mat with elbows under your shoulders. | Extend your legs behind you with toes tucked. | Make a straight line from head to heels, squeezing your core and glutes. | Hold while breathing steadily. Drop to your knees to make it easier.

name: Dead Bug
common_mistakes: Letting the lower back arch. | Moving too fast.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms reaching to the ceiling and hips and knees bent to 90 degrees. | Press your lower back gently toward the floor. | Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor. | Return to the start and switch sides.

name: Bird Dog
form_checklist: Keep hips level | Don't arch lower back
common_mistakes: Twisting the hips. | Arching the lower back.
instructions: Start on hands and knees. | Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back, keeping your hips level. | Hold for a moment with your neck neutral. | Return and switch sides.

name: Bicycle Crunch
common_mistakes: Pulling on the neck. | Rushing the movement.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and legs lifted, knees bent. | Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg. | Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion. | Keep your neck relaxed and do not pull on your head.

name: Jumping Jacks
common_mistakes: Landing with locked knees. | Holding your breath.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides. | Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead. | Jump back to the start. | Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: March in Place
common_mistakes: Leaning back. | Slouching forward.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent. | Lift your knees one at a time to a comfortable height. | Swing your arms naturally. | Keep a steady rhythm and breathe normally.

name: Brisk Walk
common_mistakes: Taking overly long strides. | Looking down at a phone.
instructions: Stand tall, look ahead and relax your shoulders. | Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing. | Swing your arms and let your heel land first. | Slow down gradually to cool off.

name: Easy Jog
common_mistakes: Starting too fast. | Overstriding. | Running in worn-out shoes.
instructions: Warm up with a brisk walk for 3 to 5 minutes. | Ease into a slow jog at a pace where you can still hold a conversation. | Take short, quiet steps landing under your body. | Finish with a few minutes of walking.

name: High Knees
common_mistakes: Leaning backward. | Landing heavily on the heels.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. | Drive one knee up toward hip height while pumping the opposite arm. | Alternate quickly, landing softly. | Keep your chest tall and core tight.

name: Burpee
common_mistakes: Sagging hips in the plank. | Rushing and losing form.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. | Squat down and place your hands on the floor. | Step or jump your feet back into a plank. | Step your feet back in, then stand and reach up. Jump only if it feels comfortable.

name: Step Jacks
common_mistakes: Letting the arms stay low. | Leaning to one side.
instructions: Stand with feet together. | Step one foot out to the side while raising both arms overhead. | Step back in and lower your arms. | Alternate sides at a smooth pace.

name: Sun Salutation (Surya Namaskar)
common_mistakes: Forcing deep bends. | Holding your breath.
instructions: Stand at the front of your mat with palms together. | Inhale and reach your arms overhead. Exhale and fold forward with soft knees. | Step back to a plank or lower to your knees, then slide forward into a gentle cobra with elbows bent. | Press back to downward dog, step forward and rise tall.

name: Balasana (Child's Pose)
common_mistakes: Forcing hips down when knees are painful. | Holding tension in the neck.
instructions: Kneel on the mat with big toes touching and knees wide apart. | Sit your hips back toward your heels and fold forward. | Rest your forehead gently on the mat and extend arms forward or alongside your body. | Breathe deeply into your lower back and ribs.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back. | Pulling the foot too hard.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance. | Bend one knee and hold your ankle behind you. | Keep your knees close together and tuck your pelvis slightly. | Hold, breathe, then switch legs.

name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
common_mistakes: Lifting the hips off the floor. | Stretching into pain.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent. | Loop a towel around one foot and raise that leg toward the ceiling. | Straighten the leg as far as is comfortable and feel a mild stretch behind the thigh. | Hold, breathe, then switch legs.

name: Virabhadrasana I (Warrior I)
common_mistakes: Letting front knee collapse inward. | Over-arching lower back.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge with front knee bent at 90 degrees. | Turn back foot out 45 degrees, grounding firmly through heel. | Square hips forward and sweep both arms straight overhead. | Hold for 5 deep breaths, then switch sides.

name: Adho Mukha Svanasana (Downward-Facing Dog)
common_mistakes: Dumping weight onto wrists. | Rounding lower back to force heels to the floor.
instructions: From hands and knees, tuck toes and lift hips toward ceiling in an inverted V. | Press evenly through all ten fingers, rotating upper arms outward. | Pedal heels gently or keep knees slightly bent to lengthen spine. | Hold for 5 smooth breaths.

name: Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose)
common_mistakes: Pushing too high too quickly and pinching the lower back. | Shrugging shoulders into the ears.
instructions: Lie face down with legs extended and tops of feet flat. | Place palms flat under your shoulders with elbows tucked close to your ribs. | Inhale and gently lift your chest off the floor using your back muscles. | Keep a soft bend in elbows and open your heart forward. | Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release down on an exhale.

name: Vrikshasana (Tree Pose)
common_mistakes: Placing the sole directly against the knee joint. | Holding your breath while balancing.
instructions: Stand tall in mountain pose with weight evenly distributed. | Shift weight to your standing leg and place the sole of the other foot against inner calf or thigh (never on the knee). | Bring hands together at prayer position in front of your chest or reach overhead. | Fix your gaze on an unmoving spot in front of you. | Hold for 30 seconds, breathe smoothly, then switch sides.

name: Paschimottanasana (Seated Forward Bend)
common_mistakes: Rounding upper back aggressively. | Pulling hard with arms.
instructions: Sit with legs straight in front of you and toes flexed back. | Inhale arms overhead, then exhale and hinge forward from hips. | Hold shins, ankles, or feet with chest leading toward thighs. | Hold for 30 to 60 seconds with steady, deep breaths.

name: Setu Bandhasana (Bridge Pose)
common_mistakes: Letting knees splay outward. | Over-compressing neck.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on mat hip-width apart. | Press feet into the floor and lift hips toward the ceiling. | Roll shoulders underneath you and lengthen tailbone toward backs of knees. | Hold for 30 seconds, breathing smoothly, then lower vertebra by vertebra.

name: Shavasana (Corpse Pose)
common_mistakes: Fidgeting or holding muscular tension in jaw and shoulders.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs naturally apart and arms beside body, palms up. | Close your eyes and release all muscular tension from head to toes. | Allow breath to become soft, natural, and effortless. | Rest quietly for 3 to 5 minutes.

name: Tadasana (Mountain Pose)
common_mistakes: Locking knees backward into hyperextension. | Tensing shoulders up around the neck.
instructions: Stand tall with big toes touching and heels slightly apart, distributing weight evenly. | Ground through the four corners of your feet and engage quadriceps lightly. | Draw your tailbone slightly down, lengthen your spine, and relax shoulders back and down. | Let arms hang naturally by your sides with palms facing forward. | Breathe steadily and hold for 30 to 60 seconds.

name: Russian Twist
common_mistakes: Only moving the arms instead of rotating the entire torso. | Slumping the spine or rounding the lower back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat or slightly elevated for a greater challenge. | Lean your torso back slightly to engage your core, keeping your spine straight. | Clasp your hands in front of your chest and rotate your torso smoothly from side to side. | Tap the floor beside your hip on each side before rotating back. | Continue for 10-15 controlled repetitions per side.

name: Mountain Climbers
common_mistakes: Bouncing hips up in the air. | Letting the shoulders drift backward away from the hands.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with shoulders directly above wrists and core tight. | Drive your right knee up toward your chest without letting your hips pike up. | Quickly switch legs, extending your right leg back while driving your left knee forward. | Maintain a steady, rhythmic pace while keeping your core braced and back flat. | Repeat continuously for 30 to 45 seconds.

name: Side Plank
common_mistakes: Dropping the hips toward the floor. | Rolling the top shoulder forward.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow directly below your shoulder and legs stacked straight. | Engage your abdominal muscles and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line. | Rest your top hand on your hip or extend it toward the ceiling. | Hold without letting your hips sag toward the mat for 20-40 seconds. | Switch sides and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
common_mistakes: Using momentum or rocking the torso to swing the weights up. | Lifting the dumbbells above shoulder height which strains the joint.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides. | With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until parallel to the floor. | Lead with the elbows, keeping your palms facing downward at the top. | Lower the dumbbells back down with control over 2 seconds. | Perform 10 to 12 controlled reps without swinging.

name: Reverse Lunge
common_mistakes: Leaning too far forward over the front knee. | Slamming the back knee into the floor.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or held at chest. | Take a controlled step backward with one leg and lower your hips. | Bend both knees to roughly 90 degrees, keeping front knee aligned over ankle. | Drive through the heel of your front foot to return to the standing position. | Alternate legs for 10-12 repetitions per leg.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
common_mistakes: Flaring elbows wide out to the sides. | Arching the lower back while pressing overhead.
instructions: Stand or sit upright holding a single dumbbell vertically overhead with both hands cup-gripping the top plate. | Keep your upper arms stationary close to your ears and elbows pointing forward. | Slowly bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head until your forearms pass parallel. | Contract your triceps to press the dumbbell back overhead to the start position. | Perform 10 to 12 controlled reps.

name: Virabhadrasana II (Warrior II)
common_mistakes: Leaning torso forward over front knee. | Letting back arm droop.
instructions: Step feet wide apart. Turn front foot out 90 degrees and back foot in slightly. | Inhale arms parallel to floor; exhale and bend front knee to 90 degrees. | Keep torso centered and gaze over front fingertips. | Hold for 5 deep breaths, then switch sides.

name: Trikonasana (Triangle Pose)
common_mistakes: Collapsing chest downward toward mat. | Locking front knee joint.
instructions: Stand with wide legs. Turn front foot out 90 degrees, back foot in slightly. | Inhale arms parallel to floor, exhale and reach sideways over front leg. | Lower front hand to shin, ankle, or block, extending top arm toward sky. | Keep chest open and hold for 5 breaths.

name: Marjaryasana (Cat Pose)
common_mistakes: Collapsing weight into wrists. | Holding breath during flexion.
instructions: Begin on all fours with wrists directly under shoulders and knees under hips. | Exhale and round your spine upward toward the ceiling, tucking your tailbone. | Gently release your head toward the floor without forcing your chin to chest. | Draw your navel in toward your spine to deeply stretch back muscles.

name: Bitilasana (Cow Pose)
common_mistakes: Over-arching the neck backward. | Hyperextending elbows.
instructions: From tabletop on all fours, inhale and drop your belly toward the mat. | Lift your chest, collarbones, and tailbone toward the ceiling. | Gaze gently forward or slightly upward without compressing back of neck. | Open through the chest while keeping core lightly engaged.

name: Sukhasana (Easy Pose)
common_mistakes: Slouching or rounding the lower back. | Tensing hips and knees.
instructions: Sit cross-legged comfortably on your mat, elevating hips on a folded blanket if needed. | Lengthen your spine upward from tailbone to crown of head. | Rest your hands palms-up or palms-down on your knees. | Relax your face and shoulders, breathing deeply and evenly.

name: Vajrasana (Thunderbolt Pose)
common_mistakes: Allowing ankles to splay wide outward. | Forcing weight when knees ache.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with knees together and big toes touching. | Lower your buttocks onto the heels, resting palms flat on thighs. | Keep the spine erect and chest open. | Breathe slowly; this pose aids digestion after meals.

name: Makarasana (Crocodile Pose)
common_mistakes: Tensing shoulder blades. | Shallow breathing.
instructions: Lie prone on your stomach with legs comfortably apart, heels turned in or out. | Cross your arms in front of you, holding opposite elbows or stacking palms. | Rest your forehead or cheek on your folded forearms. | Close your eyes and breathe deeply into the belly, relaxing the entire spine.

name: Pavanamuktasana (Wind-Relieving Pose)
common_mistakes: Lifting the head aggressively when neck is tight. | Squeezing knees beyond comfort.
instructions: Lie on your back and draw both knees gently in toward your chest. | Clasp your hands or forearms around your shins. | Keep your lower back and tailbone grounded onto the mat. | Gently rock side to side to massage your lumbar spine.

name: Baddha Konasana (Butterfly Pose)
common_mistakes: Forcefully pressing knees down with hands. | Rounding the spine into a hunch.
instructions: Sit tall with soles of your feet pressed together, drawing heels comfortably near groin. | Hold feet with hands and lengthen spine upwards. | Gently press knees down toward the floor without forcing or bouncing. | Breathe into inner thighs and hips for 30 to 60 seconds.

name: Ardha Matsyendrasana (Half Spinal Twist)
common_mistakes: Slumping through the lumbar spine while twisting. | Cranking neck excessively.
instructions: Sit with legs extended. Bend right knee and place right foot outside left thigh. | Inhale and reach left arm overhead, lengthening spine. | Exhale and twist torso right, hugging right knee with left arm or hooking elbow. | Place right fingertips on floor behind you for support. Breathe and switch sides.

name: Virabhadrasana III (Warrior III)
common_mistakes: Opening the lifted hip toward the ceiling. | Arching lower back and collapsing chest.
instructions: From a high lunge, shift weight onto your front foot. | Hinge forward at the hips, lifting back leg parallel to floor. | Extend arms forward, sideways, or alongside body, forming a T-shape. | Keep hips level and standing knee slightly soft. | Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch legs.

name: Utkatasana (Chair Pose)
common_mistakes: Knees passing far past toes. | Over-arching the lumbar spine.
instructions: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart. | Inhale and raise arms overhead, keeping shoulders relaxed. | Exhale and bend knees, sitting hips back as if into a chair. | Shift weight toward heels and keep chest lifted. | Hold for 5 breaths.

name: Natarajasana (Dancer Pose)
common_mistakes: Flaring the lifted knee out wide. | Collapsing the chest forward without kicking back.
instructions: Shift weight onto right foot. Bend left knee and grasp inside of left foot. | Reach right arm forward and upward. | Kick left foot back into hand, opening chest and tilting slightly forward. | Maintain gaze on a fixed point. Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch.

name: Garudasana (Eagle Pose)
common_mistakes: Tipping torso forward instead of keeping spine vertical. | Holding breath.
instructions: Bend knees slightly and cross right thigh over left, hooking toes behind left calf if able. | Bring arms forward, cross left arm over right at elbows, and wrap forearms to touch palms. | Lift elbows to shoulder height and sit hips deeper. | Breathe steadily for 5 breaths, then unwind and switch sides.

name: Ardha Chandrasana (Half Moon Pose)
common_mistakes: Allowing top hip to turn down toward floor. | Hyperextending standing knee.
instructions: From Triangle Pose, bend front knee and place fingertips 6-12 inches ahead on floor or block. | Lift back leg parallel to floor while straightening standing leg. | Stack hips and shoulders vertically, extending top arm toward ceiling. | Gaze sideways or upward. Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

name: Parsvakonasana (Extended Side Angle Pose)
common_mistakes: Collapsing weight into bottom shoulder. | Rounding chest down.
instructions: From Warrior II, rest front forearm on front thigh or place hand on floor/block outside foot. | Sweep top arm alongside ear, creating a straight diagonal line from back heel to fingertips. | Rotate chest open toward ceiling. | Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

name: Prasarita Padottanasana (Wide-Legged Forward Bend)
common_mistakes: Rounding back instead of hinging at hips. | Locking knee joints.
instructions: Stand with feet 3-4 feet apart, toes slightly turned in. | Place hands on hips, inhale and lengthen spine. | Exhale and hinge forward from hips, lowering palms flat to floor under shoulders. | Release crown of head toward floor, keeping legs active. | Hold for 5 to 8 breaths.

name: Dhanurasana (Bow Pose)
common_mistakes: Flaring knees wider than hips. | Holding breath during hold.
instructions: Lie on stomach, bend knees and reach back to grasp ankles. | Inhale and kick ankles back and up, lifting thighs and chest off mat. | Draw shoulder blades together and keep neck long. | Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing smoothly, then release.

name: Ustrasana (Camel Pose)
common_mistakes: Collapsing hips backward over heels. | Dropping head back aggressively.
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hips stacked directly over knees. | Place hands on lower back with fingers pointing down. | Inhale, press hips gently forward and lift chest toward ceiling. | Optionally reach hands back to touch heels while keeping hips pushed forward. | Hold for 5 breaths, then carefully rise on an inhale.

name: Janu Sirsasana (Head-to-Knee Pose)
common_mistakes: Forcing forehead to knee by rounding upper back. | Tensing shoulders.
instructions: Sit with right leg extended and left foot pressed against inner right thigh. | Inhale arms overhead, squaring chest toward right leg. | Exhale and fold forward over right thigh, holding foot or shin. | Keep spine long and breathe deeply for 5 breaths, then switch legs.

name: Gomukhasana (Cow Face Pose)
common_mistakes: Dropping chest forward to reach hands. | Forcing finger clasp.
instructions: Stack right knee directly over left knee with feet beside opposite hips. | Reach right arm overhead, bend elbow and place hand down middle of back. | Reach left arm behind back and up, clasping fingers or holding a strap. | Keep spine tall and breathe for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

name: Bakasana (Crow Pose)
common_mistakes: Looking down between hands instead of slightly forward. | Jumping instead of shifting weight with control.
instructions: Squat on mat with feet together, hands shoulder-width flat on floor. | Place knees high against backs of upper arms or armpits. | Lean forward, shift weight into hands, and lift one foot then both off mat. | Engage core and round upper back slightly. Balance for 15-30 seconds.

name: Sirsasana (Headstand)
common_mistakes: Dumping weight onto cervical spine. | Flaring elbows wide.
instructions: Interlace fingers and place forearms on mat elbow-width apart. | Crown of head rests on mat cupped by interlaced hands. | Lift hips, walk feet close, engage core, and float legs up vertically. | Press actively through forearms to keep neck free of compression. | Hold for 5 to 10 controlled breaths with wall support if needed.

name: Pincha Mayurasana (Forearm Stand)
common_mistakes: Elbows sliding out wider than shoulders. | Collapsing into shoulders (banana back).
instructions: Start on hands and knees, placing forearms parallel shoulder-width apart. | Lift hips into Dolphin Pose and walk feet toward elbows. | Gaze slightly forward between wrists, engage core, and kick or press legs up. | Draw ribs in and balance vertically over forearms for 5 breaths.

name: Adho Mukha Vrksasana (Handstand)
common_mistakes: Bending elbows upon landing. | Arching lower back excessively.
instructions: Place palms flat shoulder-width apart near a wall, spreading fingers wide. | Step one foot forward and kick back leg up into handstand. | Stack wrists, shoulders, hips, and ankles in a straight line. | Engage core and press floor actively away. Hold for 15-30 seconds.

name: Mayurasana (Peacock Pose)
common_mistakes: Elbows sliding apart away from abdomen. | Not leaning far enough forward.
instructions: Kneel with hands flat between knees, fingers pointing back toward feet. | Press elbows together into abdomen near navel. | Lean forward, extend legs straight back, and lift feet off floor parallel to mat. | Balance entirely on palms and wrists for 10-20 seconds.

name: Eka Pada Rajakapotasana (King Pigeon Pose)
common_mistakes: Forcing foot to head without hip opening. | Compressing lumbar spine.
instructions: From One-Legged Pigeon, bend back knee and point back foot toward ceiling. | Reach overhead with both hands to grasp back toes, flipping elbows forward. | Lift chest and curve spine in a deep backbend toward back foot. | Hold for 5 breaths, then carefully release and switch legs.

name: Hanumanasana (Monkey Pose / Splits)
common_mistakes: Opening the back hip wide to cheat depth. | Over-stretching tight hamstrings.
instructions: From a low lunge, slide front foot forward while sliding back leg straight back. | Keep hips squared forward, using blocks under hands for support. | Slowly lower pelvis toward mat until both legs are straight. | Bring hands to heart or raise arms overhead. Breathe and switch sides.

name: Urdhva Dhanurasana (Wheel Pose)
common_mistakes: Flaring feet and knees wide apart. | Dumping weight into lower back instead of opening chest.
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat and hands beside ears with fingers pointing toward shoulders. | Press into feet and hands simultaneously to lift body up into a full arch. | Roll shoulders open, press chest toward wall behind you, and relax neck. | Hold for 5 deep breaths, then tuck chin and lower down slowly.

name: Eka Pada Koundinyasana (Flying Splits Pose)
common_mistakes: Dropping chest too low to floor. | Not engaging core and adductors.
instructions: From a lunge, hook front thigh over back of front upper arm. | Plant both palms firmly on floor shoulder-width apart. | Shift chest forward into Chaturanga arms, lift back leg and extend front leg straight. | Hover both legs split in air for 10-20 seconds, then switch sides.

name: Astavakrasana (Eight-Angle Pose)
common_mistakes: Failing to squeeze upper arm with legs. | Dropping shoulder below elbow height.
instructions: Sit with legs out. Hook right leg high over right upper arm. | Plant hands on floor, cross left ankle over right ankle. | Press into hands to lift hips off floor, bend elbows to 90 degrees. | Extend both legs straight out to the right side, chest parallel to floor. | Hold for 5 breaths, then repeat on opposite side.

name: Tittibhasana (Firefly Pose)
common_mistakes: Slumping weight backward onto hips. | Letting feet drop toward floor.
instructions: Squat with feet slightly wider than mat. Work shoulders underneath thighs. | Plant palms flat on floor behind heels. | Shift weight back onto hands, lift feet off mat, and straighten legs out to sides. | Press firmly through hands, engage inner thighs, and lift chest for 5 breaths.

name: Vrschikasana (Scorpion Pose)
common_mistakes: Attempting before mastering forearm stand. | Collapsing into shoulders.
instructions: Begin in a stable Forearm Stand (Pincha Mayurasana). | Bend knees and begin arching spine, dropping feet toward crown of head. | Lift chest and head forward, gazing toward hands. | Hold for 3 to 5 controlled breaths, then return to forearm stand and lower.

name: Parsva Bakasana (Side Crow Pose)
common_mistakes: Not twisting deep enough before placing hands. | Dropping head to floor.
instructions: Squat and twist torso deeply to the right, placing both hands flat on floor outside right thigh. | Rest outer right thigh across back of left upper arm. | Shift chest forward, bend elbows to 90 degrees, and float feet off floor. | Hold for 15-20 seconds, then switch sides.

name: Kapotasana (Pigeon Pose / Full Backbend)
common_mistakes: Pinching lower back without thoracic expansion. | Restricting breath.
instructions: Kneel upright with knees hip-width apart. | Inhale and reach arms overhead; exhale and arch backward into a deep backbend. | Lower forearms to floor and walk hands to grasp heels or ankles. | Drop head gently back, press thighs forward, and hold for 5 breaths.

name: Kukkutasana (Rooster Pose)
common_mistakes: Attempting without comfortable Padmasana. | Collapsing chest downward.
instructions: Sit in full Lotus Pose (Padmasana). | Slide arms down through the space between thighs and calves until palms reach floor. | Spread fingers wide and press firmly into mat. | Engage core and lift entire body and lotus legs off floor, balancing on palms. | Hold for 10-20 seconds, breathing steadily.

name: Arm Circles
form_checklist: Keep shoulders relaxed away from ears | Maintain controlled circular speed
common_mistakes: Dropping arms below shoulder height. | Shrugging shoulders up to ears. | Arching lower back aggressively.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and extend your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height. | Make small, controlled circular motions forward with both arms. | Gradually increase circle diameter to mobilize shoulder capsules and rotator cuffs. | Reverse direction halfway through to work opposing muscle groups.

name: Shoulder Rolls
form_checklist: Full circular range of motion | Keep spine upright and neck relaxed
common_mistakes: Jerkiness or rushing through the motion. | Holding your breath. | Leaning neck forward.
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed naturally at your sides. | Lift shoulders up toward your ears, roll them backward, squeeze shoulder blades together, then lower down. | Perform smooth, fluid circular motions to release upper neck and shoulder tension. | Switch to rolling forward halfway through.

name: Hip Circles
form_checklist: Keep knees soft and unlocked | Make full, fluid circles
common_mistakes: Moving only the upper torso instead of hips. | Locking knees stiffly. | Rushing the circular movement.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, placing hands firmly on your hips. | Rotate your hips in wide, smooth clockwise circles. | Engage core gently while opening up pelvic girdle, hip flexors, and lower back. | Reverse direction and complete equal rotations counter-clockwise.

name: Ankle Rotations
form_checklist: Isolate movement to ankle joint | Maintain balance or hold wall if needed
common_mistakes: Moving entire leg instead of just ankle joint. | Rushing through the range of motion.
instructions: Stand tall or sit comfortably with one foot lifted slightly off the floor. | Rotate foot and ankle in slow, complete circles in a clockwise direction. | Complete desired reps, then rotate counter-clockwise. | Switch feet and repeat to prepare calves and ankles for impact.

name: Hip Rotations
form_checklist: Keep torso square facing front | Move knee through controlled circular arc
common_mistakes: Twisting upper body to compensate for limited hip range. | Losing balance or rushing reps.
instructions: Stand on one leg while lifting the opposite knee up to hip level. | Open the knee out to the side in a smooth arc, then lower back to starting position. | Alternate legs or complete sets on one side before switching. | Hold onto a sturdy wall or surface if you need balance support.

name: Leg Swings
form_checklist: Maintain tall, upright posture | Swing leg from hip joint with relaxed control
common_mistakes: Excessive arching of lower back during backswing. | Forcing height instead of maintaining relaxed momentum.
instructions: Stand beside a wall or sturdy support, holding it lightly with one hand. | Swing the outer leg forward and backward smoothly in a pendulum motion. | Allow hamstring and hip flexor to dynamically stretch without forcing end range. | Switch sides and repeat with other leg.

name: Inchworms
form_checklist: Brace core tightly at plank top | Feel gentle stretch through hamstrings on hinge
common_mistakes: Sagging hips in plank position. | Rushing hand steps without core stability.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. | Hinge forward at hips and place hands on the floor (bend knees slightly if hamstrings are tight). | Walk hands forward one by one until you reach a straight-arm plank position. | Hold for a brief moment, then walk hands back toward feet and stand up tall.

name: Arm Swings
form_checklist: Alternate crossing arm on each repetition | Feel dynamic stretch across chest and upper back
common_mistakes: Flailing arms with uncontrolled hyper-extension. | Slouching shoulders forward.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. | Swing both arms across the front of your chest, alternating which arm crosses on top. | Open arms wide horizontally to stretch chest and shoulders dynamically. | Maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout.

name: Dynamic Lunges
form_checklist: Chest lifted and shoulders back | Knee tracks in line with second toe
common_mistakes: Front knee shooting past toes. | Torso collapsing forward. | Slamming back knee into floor.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and hands on hips. | Step forward smoothly into a controlled lunge, lowering hips until front thigh is parallel to ground. | Push off front foot in one fluid motion to return to starting stance. | Immediately step forward with opposite leg and alternate continuously.

name: Wall Push-ups
form_checklist: Body stays in straight rigid line | Elbows track back at roughly 45 degrees
common_mistakes: Sagging hips or piking buttocks back. | Shrugging shoulders into neck.
instructions: Stand arm-length away from a sturdy wall with feet hip-width apart. | Place palms flat against wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart. | Keeping body straight from head to heels, bend elbows to lower chest toward wall. | Press through palms to push back to straight arms.

name: Knee Push-ups
form_checklist: Core braced with straight line from knees to head | Smooth, controlled descent
common_mistakes: Leaving hips raised in the air (piking). | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides. | Letting head drop forward.
instructions: Start on all fours, then walk hands forward and lower hips so body forms a straight line from knees to head. | Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Lower chest toward the floor until elbows bend to 90 degrees. | Press through palms firmly to return to the starting plank position on knees.

name: Chair Squats
form_checklist: Light touch on the seat | Keep chest upright and weight centered over midfoot
common_mistakes: Dropping heavily onto chair without control. | Knees caving inward on ascent. | Heels peeling off the ground.
instructions: Stand a few inches in front of a sturdy chair with feet shoulder-width apart. | Push hips back and bend knees, lowering slowly until glutes lightly touch the seat. | Do not collapse your weight onto the chair; pause for a half-second. | Drive through your heels and stand up tall, squeezing glutes at the top.

name: Knee Plank
form_checklist: Keep elbows directly stacked under shoulders | Tuck pelvis slightly to engage lower abs
common_mistakes: Arching lower back and letting belly sag. | Piking hips up toward the ceiling. | Holding breath.
instructions: Rest on your forearms and knees, with elbows directly under shoulders. | Walk knees back slightly so your body forms a straight line from knees to head. | Engage your abdominal wall and glutes, keeping your spine neutral. | Breathe steadily and hold for the target duration.

name: Wide-Grip Push-ups
form_checklist: Engage chest muscles actively at lockout | Do not allow head to crane forward
common_mistakes: Flaring elbows out at 90 degrees which overloads shoulder joints. | Sagging midsection.
instructions: Set up in a high plank position with hands placed about 1.5 times shoulder-width apart. | Keep your body straight from heels to head with core braced. | Lower chest toward floor by bending elbows outwards at roughly 45 to 60 degrees. | Push through palms to return to full lockout.

name: Diamond Push-ups
form_checklist: Keep elbows tracking tight to ribs | Squeeze triceps at top of repetition
common_mistakes: Flaring elbows wide. | Letting hips drop or piking backwards.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands directly under chest, thumbs and index fingers touching to form a diamond or triangle shape. | Maintain a rigid plank alignment from head to heels. | Lower chest toward your hands while keeping elbows tucked close to your ribcage. | Drive powerfully through palms and triceps to push back to top position.

name: Sumo Squats
form_checklist: Keep knees tracking wide over toes | Squeeze inner thighs and glutes at peak
common_mistakes: Knees collapsing inward past toes. | Leaning torso excessively forward.
instructions: Stand with feet considerably wider than shoulder-width, toes turned outward at 45 degrees. | Keep chest upright and hands clasped in front of your chest. | Bend knees and push hips back, tracking knees directly over your flared toes. | Descend until thighs are parallel to ground, then drive through heels to stand tall.

name: Jump Squats
form_checklist: Land quietly and smoothly absorb shock | Drive with maximum vertical power
common_mistakes: Landing with stiff, locked knees (jarring joints). | Letting knees cave inward upon impact.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides. | Hinge and bend knees into a quarter-to-half squat, swinging arms back. | Explosively extend hips, knees, and ankles, driving arms up and jumping into the air. | Land softly on balls of feet and absorb impact by sinking immediately into the next squat.

name: Walking Lunges
form_checklist: Keep torso upright and proud | Hover back knee just an inch above floor
common_mistakes: Taking too short strides which strains front patella. | Letting torso sway side-to-side.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and hands on hips or at your sides. | Take a large step forward with your right leg, lowering hips until front thigh is parallel to floor. | Drive through right heel and step your left leg forward directly into the next lunge. | Continue walking forward in a smooth, continuous alternating cadence.

name: Bulgarian Split Squats
form_checklist: 80% of weight supported by front leg | Keep torso tall with slight forward hinge
common_mistakes: Placing front foot too close to bench, crowding front knee. | Pushing off the rear elevated foot.
instructions: Stand about two feet in front of a bench or chair, facing away. | Reach one foot back and rest the top of your foot on the elevated surface. | Lower your hips straight down until your front thigh is roughly parallel to floor. | Drive through your front heel to stand back up, keeping rear leg relaxed.

name: Decline Push-ups
form_checklist: Shift focus to upper chest and anterior deltoids | Keep neck aligned with spine
common_mistakes: Sagging hips or hyperextending neck. | Flaring elbows straight out.
instructions: Kneel facing away from a sturdy bench, chair, or bed. | Place hands flat on floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, then place toes on the elevated surface. | Brace core to form a rigid line from toes to head. | Lower chest toward floor until elbows bend to 90 degrees, then press back up forcefully.

name: Archer Push-ups
form_checklist: Keep extended arm straight with palm on floor | Maintain tight plank posture throughout
common_mistakes: Bending both arms equally instead of isolating one side. | Twisting hips away from horizontal alignment.
instructions: Set up in a pushup position with hands placed significantly wider than normal. | Lower your body toward one side, bending that arm fully while extending the other arm straight out. | Press back up to the center using the bent working arm. | Repeat on the opposite side, alternating smoothly like an archer drawing a bow.

name: Explosive Push-ups
form_checklist: Explosive upward drive | Soft, controlled landing absorption
common_mistakes: Landing with stiff, locked elbows. | Losing core tension and flopping hips.
instructions: Start in a standard pushup position with core tightly braced. | Lower chest down under control until an inch above the floor. | Explosively push through your hands with maximum speed so hands leave the ground momentarily. | Land with soft, unlocked elbows and immediately descend into the next repetition.

name: Pike Push-ups
form_checklist: Crown of head touches floor ahead of hands (forming a triangle) | Keep hips high throughout
common_mistakes: Flaring elbows out instead of tucking back at 45 degrees. | Letting hips drop into a standard pushup.
instructions: Begin in a downward-dog or inverted V position with hands shoulder-width and hips pushed high. | Shift your weight forward so shoulders are stacked directly over wrists. | Bend elbows and lower crown of head forward and down in a diagonal arc between hands. | Press through shoulders and palms to push back up into the high pike.

name: Assisted Pistol Squats
form_checklist: Keep foot completely flat on the floor | Use hand support only for balance and minimal assistance
common_mistakes: Heel lifting off the floor. | Collapsing knee inward. | Pulling too hard with arm instead of driving with leg.
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with a wall, doorframe, or sturdy post at your side for balance. | Extend the non-working leg straight out in front of you. | Lower down on your standing leg into a deep, full single-leg squat, using hand support as needed. | Press through heel and midfoot to stand back up without relying purely on hand assistance.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
form_checklist: Keep pelvis level and square throughout | Drive through planted heel
common_mistakes: Hyperextending lower back at top. | Dropping or rotating hips unevenly.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. | Lift one leg off the ground, extending it straight or holding knee toward chest. | Drive through the heel of the planted foot, raising hips until thighs and torso align. | Squeeze the working glute hard at top, lower slowly, and repeat before switching sides.

name: Plank to Push-up
form_checklist: Lock core and glutes to minimize hip sway | Place palms directly where elbows were
common_mistakes: Excessive rocking or swaying of hips side-to-side. | Placing hands too far forward of shoulders.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with elbows directly under shoulders. | Place right hand flat under right shoulder and push up, immediately followed by left hand to reach high plank. | Lower right elbow back down, then left elbow back to forearm plank. | Alternate the leading arm on each rep to balance triceps and shoulder effort.

name: V-ups
form_checklist: Exhale on contraction as you fold into V | Control descent smoothly
common_mistakes: Bending knees excessively. | Using momentum or throwing arms rather than contracting abs. | Slamming back down onto floor.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight together and arms extended overhead. | Engage your core to simultaneously lift your straight legs and upper torso off the floor. | Reach hands toward toes, forming a crisp V-shape balancing on your glutes. | Lower under control back to starting position without letting lower back arch.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
form_checklist: Keep torso upright and proud | Maintain slight posterior pelvic tilt
common_mistakes: Arching lower back rather than tucking pelvis. | Leaning torso forward.
instructions: Kneel on your back knee with the front foot planted flat at 90 degrees. | Tuck your pelvis slightly underneath you to engage glutes. | Shift your weight gently forward until you feel a deep stretch in the front of your back hip. | Hold with tall spine and relaxed breathing, then switch sides.

name: Chest Stretch
form_checklist: Elbow bent 90 degrees against wall | Breathe deeply to allow muscles to relax
common_mistakes: Shrugging shoulder up toward ear. | Forcing or jerking into the stretch.
instructions: Stand next to a wall or doorway, placing one forearm and elbow flat at shoulder height. | Step forward with the inside leg and gently turn your body away. | Feel a broad opening stretch across your chest and anterior shoulder. | Breathe deeply for the duration, then switch sides.

name: Pigeon Stretch
form_checklist: Keep pelvis level and square to ground | Place folded towel under hip if tight
common_mistakes: Collapsing all weight onto one side of hip. | Torquing front knee sharply.
instructions: From all fours, slide right knee forward behind right wrist, angling right foot toward left hip. | Slide left leg straight back along the floor, pointing toes. | Lower hips square toward the floor, keeping hands on ground for support or resting on forearms. | Hold and breathe into the deep outer hip and glute stretch before switching sides.

name: Deep Breathing
form_checklist: Diaphragmatic expansion on inhale | Long, smooth, calming exhalation
common_mistakes: Shallow chest breathing. | Tensing neck and shoulders.
instructions: Sit comfortably or lie on your back with hands resting softly on your belly. | Inhale slowly and deeply through your nose for 4 seconds, feeling your belly expand. | Hold gently for 2 seconds. | Exhale slowly and completely through your mouth for 6 seconds, letting your body fully relax.

name: Neck Rotations (Gentle)
form_checklist: Keep shoulders relaxed and still | Slow and controlled circular motion
common_mistakes: Jerking or moving too quickly. | Forcing the head backward into a pinch. | Tensing the shoulders upward.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with shoulders relaxed down and away from your ears. | Slowly and gently roll your head in a smooth circle, moving right, back, left, and forward. | Avoid forcing the range of motion; maintain slow, relaxed breathing. | Reverse directions smoothly after completing the desired repetitions.

name: Standing Crunches
form_checklist: Fingertips light on ears | Focus on driving knee up and crunching abs
common_mistakes: Pulling on the neck with hands. | Dropping the chest without engaging the abdominal wall.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, fingertips lightly resting behind your ears. | Shift weight to your left leg, brace your core, and lift your right knee diagonally across your torso. | Crunch your left elbow toward your right knee to contract your obliques and abs. | Lower your foot with control and alternate sides with each rep.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-ups
form_checklist: Shoulders stay well ahead of wrists | Core stays braced in a hollow body position
common_mistakes: Sagging hips or arched lower back. | Losing the forward lean during the press.
instructions: Set up in a standard push-up position with fingers pointed slightly outward. | Walk your hands down toward your waist and lean your shoulders well in front of your wrists. | Maintain protraction (hollow body) and lower yourself until your chest nears the floor. | Press through your palms to return to the top while sustaining the forward shoulder lean.

name: Jump Lunges
form_checklist: Land softly on the balls of your feet | Chest upright and core braced
common_mistakes: Landing heavily on the back knee. | Front knee collapsing inward upon impact.
instructions: Begin in a lunge stance with both knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Explode vertically upward, swinging your arms for balance and momentum. | Switch your leg positions in mid-air and land softly into the opposite lunge. | Immediately sink into the lunge to absorb the landing and transition smoothly into the next jump.

name: Single-Leg Squats
form_checklist: Keep working heel flat | Knee tracks directly over second toe
common_mistakes: Heel lifting off the floor. | Excessive rounding of the spine.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg elevated in front or bent behind you. | Reach your arms forward for balance, push your hips back, and bend your working knee. | Lower yourself down into a deep squat while keeping your heel grounded. | Drive firmly through your heel and midfoot to return to full standing lockout.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
form_checklist: Zero swinging momentum | Controlled lift using abdominal power
common_mistakes: Using swinging momentum to propel legs up. | Arching lower back on the way down.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your body fully extended. | Engage your lats to prevent body swing and brace your core. | Raise your straight legs smoothly until they reach hip height (or higher). | Pause briefly, then lower your legs with strict eccentric control.

name: L-sit Hold
form_checklist: Shoulders depressed and locked | Legs fully straight and parallel
common_mistakes: Bent knees and drooping legs. | Shrugging shoulders up toward ears.
instructions: Sit with legs straight out on the floor or parallettes, palms planted beside your hips. | Depress your scapulae firmly by pushing into the floor to elevate your torso. | Contract your hip flexors, quads, and abs to lift your straight legs parallel to the floor. | Lock your knees, point your toes, and breathe steadily for the prescribed duration.

name: Handstand Push-up Progression
form_checklist: Tripod head-and-hand positioning | Full lock-out at the top
common_mistakes: Elbows flaring excessively out to the sides. | Over-arching the lower back like a banana.
instructions: Kick up into a wall-supported handstand (or assume an elevated pike handstand stance). | Maintain a tight hollow core with arms fully extended and shoulders shrugged up. | Slowly lower yourself by bending your elbows slightly forward, creating a tripod shape with your head and hands. | Press firmly through your palms and deltoids back to the locked-out handstand position.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
form_checklist: Keep torso upright and neck neutral | Gentle, steady stretch without forcing
common_mistakes: Pushing the head forward with the arm. | Over-arching the lower back.
instructions: Stand or sit tall, reach one arm straight overhead, and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your neck. | Use your other hand to gently guide the elbow backward and down until you feel a comfortable stretch along the back of the arm. | Keep your neck relaxed, spine upright, and hold while breathing deeply. | Switch arms and repeat on the opposite side.
